test_find_node_split: test the Splitter.find_node_split method to find the best feature and bin split given histograms, gradients, and hessians
test_split_indices: test the Splitter.split_indices method to partition sample indices into left and right child sets based on a split decision
test_compute_histograms_brute: test the HistogramBuilder.compute_histograms_brute method to build per-feature histograms of gradients and hessians
test_compute_node_value: test the compute_node_value function to compute node prediction values from summed gradients and hessians
test_splitter_constraints: test the Splitter class with various constraints including min_samples_leaf, min_gain_to_split, missing values, categorical features, and interaction constraints
